ordered_operations: reveal three Islands, a Mountain, and Twinflame from the actual library
enumerate all legal unordered splits in the rules layer
ask the frozen provider for the minimizing split and caster pile
move the chosen pile to hand and the other pile to graveyard
replay the recorded choices without policy code
preconditions: The scenario is constructed with build_exact_game().
The contextual_combo_v1 evaluator ID and SHA-256 are frozen before the choice.
Three Islands are already controlled on Turn 3, Dualcaster Mage is in hand, and the mana pool is explicitly funded for the test cast.
required_assertions: the kernel does not contain card-value weights
the choice record contains evaluator ID and SHA-256
all five revealed physical cards end in exactly one of hand or graveyard
the unchosen pile contains at least one card and moves to graveyard
fresh replay reproduces the exact recorded selection
the transcript does not invent a Sol Ring or MANA_PRODUCED event absent from the named test

plain_english: The exact frozen deck is placed in a Turn 3 fixture with three Islands on the battlefield, Dualcaster Mage in hand, and an explicitly funded legal mana pool; the fixture does not use Sol Ring.

Fact or Fiction is cast and reveals three Islands, a Mountain, and Twinflame from the actual library; the frozen provider chooses a legal minimizing split and the caster keeps a pile containing Twinflame.
Every revealed physical card moves to exactly one of hand or graveyard, and fresh replay reproduces the recorded choices without rerunning policy code.
title: Fact or Fiction uses the frozen contextual evaluator and moves both piles through the production path
